newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Gas explosion injures eight Romanian coalminers.
newsitem.headline: Gas explosion injures eight Romanian coalminers.

text.p: A gas leak in Romania's Jiu Valley coalfield injured eight miners, four seriously, in the latest of a long series of accidents blamed by trade unionists on poor standards and equipment.

"This is a typical mine accident like dozens we have in the Jiu Valley each year," Dr Sorin Bratila said by telephone from a hospital in the Valley's main centre, Petrosani, 400 km (250 miles) west of Bucharest.
He said four of the victims suffered massive burns and had little chance of surviving. The others suffered less serious injuries and carbon monoxide poisoning.
Miners' unions often complain about difficult conditions, including poor ventilation, obsolete safety equipment and low quality explosives.
